question: How do I apply for annual leave?
answer: You can apply for annual leave via the HR portal (Workday) under the 'Time Off' section. Submit your request at least 2 weeks in advance and discuss it with your manager beforehand.

question: What is the policy for sick leave?
answer: All employees are entitled to 12 days of paid sick leave per year. If you are sick for more than 3 consecutive days, you must submit a medical certificate from a registered practitioner to HR.

question: How do I claim my health insurance?
answer: To claim medical insurance, log into the insurer portal (MediShield) using your employee ID. Submit the itemized hospital/clinic receipt along with the claim form. Claims are usually processed within 7-10 business days.

question: Does the company offer a gym or wellness allowance?
answer: Yes, the company offers a Wellness Allowance of up to $50 per month. You can claim reimbursement for gym memberships, fitness classes, wellness apps, or sporting equipment under the 'Wellness' expense category in Workday.

question: When is salary paid each month?
answer: Salaries are processed and credited on the 25th of each month. If the 25th falls on a weekend or public holiday, salary will be paid on the preceding business day.

question: How do I download my monthly payslip?
answer: Payslips are available on the Workday portal. Navigate to 'Pay' > 'Payslips' to view and download PDF versions of your monthly payslips.

question: What is the remote work policy?
answer: Our current policy allows a hybrid model: up to 2 days of remote work per week, with mandatory in-office presence on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Coordinate your remote days with your team lead.

question: How do I request a new laptop or hardware?
answer: For hardware upgrades or replacements, open an IT request ticket on the ServiceDesk portal under 'Request Hardware'. Hardware requests require approval from your manager.

question: How can I reset my work email password?
answer: You can reset your Okta password by visiting portal.okta.com and clicking 'Forgot Password'. Alternatively, contact the IT hotline at ext. 4357 or email support@company.com.

question: What is the policy for parental/maternity leave?
answer: The company offers 16 weeks of paid maternity leave and 4 weeks of paid paternity leave for eligible employees. Please notify HR and your manager at least 10 weeks before your expected start date.
